title.zh: 卷278 列傳六十五 慕天颜 阿山 噶礼
title.en: Volume 278 Biographies 65: Mu Tianyan, A Shan, Ga Li
title.raw: 卷278 列傳六十五 慕天颜 阿山 噶礼

sentences.zh: 列傳六十五

translations.literal: Biographies 65
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 65

sentences.zh: 慕天顏阿山噶禮

translations.literal: Mu Tianyan, A Shan, and Ga Li
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tianyan, A Shan, and Ga Li

sentences.zh: 慕天顏，字拱極，甘肅靜寧人。

translations.literal: Mu Tianyan, whose courtesy name was Gongji, was a native of Jingning in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tianyan, styled Gongji, came from Jingning in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 順治十二年進士，授浙江錢塘知縣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Shunzhi he passed the metropolitan examination and was appointed magistrate of Qiantang in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of Shunzhi 12, he was made magistrate of Qiantang in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 遷廣西南寧同知，再遷福建興化知府。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be subprefect of Nanning in Guangxi, and later promoted to prefect of Xinghua in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: He was moved to subprefect of Nanning in Guangxi, then promoted to prefect of Xinghua in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 康熙九年，擢湖廣上荊南道。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Kangxi he was promoted to the Shang-Jingnan circuit in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 9 he was raised to the Shang-Jingnan circuit in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 總督劉兆麒疏言天顏習邊海諸事，請調福建興泉道。

translations.literal: Governor Liu Zhaoqi memorialized that Tianyan was versed in coastal affairs and requested his transfer to the Xing-Quan circuit in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Liu Zhaoqi reported that Tianyan was experienced in maritime border matters and asked that he be transferred to the Xing-Quan circuit in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 尋擢江蘇布政使。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was promoted to Jiangsu provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was made Jiangsu provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 十二年，喪母。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year his mother died.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 12 his mother died.

sentences.zh: 總督麻勒吉、巡撫瑪祜疏言：「天顏廉明勤敏，清積年逋賦，釐剔挪移，事未竟，請令在官守制。」

translations.literal: Governor Malaqi and Governor-General Ma Hu memorialized: "Tianyan is incorrupt, clear, diligent, and sharp. He is clearing years of arrears in land tax and grain levies and rectifying diversions and transfers; the work is not yet finished. We ask that he be allowed to observe mourning while remaining in office."
translations.idiomatic: Governor Malaqi and Governor-General Ma Hu wrote: "Tianyan is honest, capable, and energetic. He is clearing long-standing tax arrears and untangling misallocated payments, but the task is unfinished. We ask that he be permitted to observe mourning without leaving his post."

sentences.zh: 十三年，入覲，疏言：「江南田地錢糧有隱佔、詭寄諸弊，臣飭州縣通計田額，均分里甲；

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he came to audience and memorialized: "In Jiangnan there are abuses such as concealed occupation of fields and fraudulent registration of land. Your servant has ordered the prefectures and counties to tally field quotas in full and distribute the burden evenly among li and jia;
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 13 he had an audience with the throne and reported: "Jiangnan land taxes suffer from hidden occupation, false registration, and similar abuses. I have ordered the prefectures and counties to calculate the full field quota and spread the burden evenly across li and jia units;

sentences.zh: 又因科則不等，立徵收截票之法，每戶實徵錢糧分十限，於開徵日給限票，依限完納截票。

translations.literal: and because tax rates were unequal, he established a method of receipt-stub collection: each household's actual levy was divided into ten installments; on the day collection opened, installment tickets were issued, and payment was made by installment with the stub returned.
translations.idiomatic: and because tax schedules varied, he instituted a stub-receipt system: each household's actual levy was split into ten installments, tickets were issued when collection opened, and taxpayers paid by installment and surrendered each stub on completion.

sentences.zh: 逾限未截，按數追比，吏不能欺民。」

translations.literal: If the deadline passed without surrender of the stub, collection was pressed by the amount due, so clerks could not cheat the people."
translations.idiomatic: Missed deadlines triggered exact collection, so clerks could no longer cheat the taxpayers."

sentences.zh: 下部，著為令。

translations.literal: The Board received the memorial and it was enacted as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial went to the ministries and was promulgated as standing regulation.

sentences.zh: 十五年，擢江寧巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was promoted to governor of Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 15 he was made governor of Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 疏進錢糧交代冊，上嘉其清晰，命布政使交代當以此為式。

translations.literal: He memorialized and submitted a handover register for land tax and grain levies. The emperor praised its clarity and ordered that provincial treasurers' handovers should follow this model.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a handover register for tax and grain accounts. The emperor praised its clarity and decreed that all provincial treasurers should use it as the standard.

sentences.zh: 尋以節減驛站錢糧，加兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward, for economizing on courier-station funds and grain, he was given the additional title of vice minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, for cutting courier-station expenses, he received the additional rank of vice minister of war.

sentences.zh: 師徵吳三桂，大將軍貝勒尚善請造船濟師，下天顏督造送岳州。

translations.literal: When the army marched against Wu Sangui, Grand General Prince Shangshan requested boats to ferry the troops, and Tianyan was ordered to supervise construction and deliver them to Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: During the campaign against Wu Sangui, Grand General Prince Shangshan asked for transport vessels, and Tianyan was ordered to build them and send them to Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 敘勞，加太子少保、兵部尚書，仍兼右副都御史。

translations.literal: For his merit he was given the additional titles of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and minister of war, while retaining his concurrent post as vice censor-in-chief on the right.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and minister of war, while continuing as vice censor-in-chief on the right.

sentences.zh: 時諸道兵應徵發，舳艫蔽江，夫役牽挽，動以千萬計。

translations.literal: At that time troops from every circuit were being mobilized; boats covered the rivers, and trackers and laborers for towing numbered in the millions.
translations.idiomatic: Troops from every circuit were being mobilized; the river was thick with boats, and the trackers hauling them ran into the millions.

sentences.zh: 天顏疏言：「縴夫募諸民間，夫給銀一錢。

translations.literal: Tianyan memorialized: "Tracking laborers are recruited from among the people, with one mace of silver per man.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyan wrote: "Tracking crews are drafted from the populace at one mace of silver per man.

sentences.zh: 民爭逃匿，計裡均派，先期拘集，飢寒踣頓。

translations.literal: The people flee and hide; quotas are assigned by li, men are seized in advance, and they collapse from hunger and cold.
translations.idiomatic: People flee and hide; quotas are levied by li, men are rounded up ahead of time, and many collapse from hunger and cold.

sentences.zh: 及兵既到，計船給夫，兵與船戶橫索財物，鞭撻死傷。

translations.literal: When the troops arrive, trackers are assigned by boat; soldiers and boatmen extort goods by force, beating men to death or injury.
translations.idiomatic: When troops arrive, trackers are assigned boat by boat; soldiers and boatmen extort goods by force, beating people to death or crippling them.

sentences.zh: 臣擬軍赴前敵，仍給縴夫；

translations.literal: Your servant proposes that when troops go to the front, trackers should still be provided;
translations.idiomatic: I propose that troops marching to the front should still receive trackers;

sentences.zh: 其凱旋還京，並各省調遣歸標官兵，每船應夫若干，以其直給船戶，令僱水手。」

translations.literal: but for those returning in triumph to the capital, and for garrison troops recalled from the provinces, each boat should receive a fixed number of trackers, the fee paid to the boat owner, who should hire sailors."
translations.idiomatic: but for victorious returns to the capital and for garrison troops recalled from the provinces, each boat should receive a fixed allowance paid to the owner to hire sailors instead."

sentences.zh: 上從之，命下直省，著為令。

translations.literal: The emperor approved and ordered it sent to all provinces as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed and ordered the rule sent to every province.

sentences.zh: 江南水道交錯，天顏為布政使時，請於巡撫瑪祜，濬吳淞江、劉河淤道。

translations.literal: Jiangnan's waterways crisscross one another. While Tianyan was provincial treasurer, he asked Governor-General Ma Hu to dredge the silted channels of the Wusong River and the Liu River.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan's waterways form a dense network. As provincial treasurer, Tianyan asked Governor-General Ma Hu to dredge the silted Wusong and Liu rivers.

sentences.zh: 十九年，江南困霪雨，疏言：「附近吳淞江、劉河諸州縣水道通暢，旋溢旋消。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Jiangnan suffered from prolonged rain. He memorialized: "In the prefectures and counties near the Wusong and Liu rivers the waterways are open and floods rise and fall quickly.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 19 Jiangnan was battered by endless rain. He reported: "Near the Wusong and Liu rivers the channels are open and floods rise and subside quickly.

sentences.zh: 宜興、常熟、武進、江陰、金壇諸縣水無出路，或要口湮塞，致積雨成壑。

translations.literal: In Yixing, Changshu, Wujin, Jiangyin, Jintan, and other counties the water has no outlet, or key mouths are blocked, so accumulated rain forms deep pools.
translations.idiomatic: In Yixing, Changshu, Wujin, Jiangyin, Jintan, and other counties water has nowhere to go, or critical outlets are choked, so the rains have turned fields into lakes.

sentences.zh: 常熟白茆港為長洲、崑山、無錫諸水出海要道，武進孟瀆河為丹陽、宜興、金壇諸水歸江要道，請動帑疏濬。」

translations.literal: Baimao Harbor in Changshu is the main outlet to the sea for the waters of Changzhou, Kunshan, and Wuxi; the Mengdu River in Wujin is the main route to the Yangtze for the waters of Danyang, Yixing, and Jintan. He requested treasury funds for dredging."
translations.idiomatic: Baimao Harbor in Changshu is the main outlet to the sea for Changzhou, Kunshan, and Wuxi; the Mengdu River in Wujin is the main route to the Yangtze for Danyang, Yixing, and Jintan. He asked for treasury funds to dredge them."

sentences.zh: 上從之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 於是濬白茆港四十三里達海，濬孟瀆河四十八里達江，皆建閘以時啟閉，費帑九萬有奇。

translations.literal: Baimao Harbor was then dredged for forty-three li to reach the sea, and the Mengdu River for forty-eight li to reach the Yangtze; sluice gates were built at each and opened and closed on schedule, at a cost of more than ninety thousand taels of treasury silver.
translations.idiomatic: Baimao Harbor was dredged forty-three li to the sea and the Mengdu River forty-eight li to the Yangtze; sluice gates were built and operated on schedule, at a cost of more than ninety thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 又嘗疏請減浮糧，除版荒、坍沒公佔田地，部議坍沒許豁除，版荒令覆勘。

translations.literal: He also once memorialized to reduce excess grain levies and cancel tax on abandoned fields, collapsed land, and publicly occupied plots. The ministry ruled that collapsed land might be written off, but abandoned fields must be re-surveyed.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to cut excess grain levies and remove tax on abandoned, collapsed, and illegally occupied land. The ministry allowed write-offs for collapsed fields but ordered fresh surveys for abandoned land.

sentences.zh: 二十年，疏請募民墾版荒，六年後起科。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he memorialized to recruit people to reclaim abandoned land, with taxation to begin after six years.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 20 he asked to recruit settlers for abandoned land, with taxation deferred for six years.

sentences.zh: 揚州知府高德貴虧帑數万，既劾罷，旋卒；

translations.literal: Yangzhou Prefect Gao Degui had a treasury shortfall of tens of thousands; he was impeached and dismissed, then soon died;
translations.idiomatic: Yangzhou Prefect Gao Degui had embezzled tens of thousands from the treasury; after impeachment and dismissal he soon died;

sentences.zh: 天顏疏銷草豆價，戶部覈減七千有奇，天顏檄追德貴家屬。

translations.literal: Tianyan memorialized to write off fodder and bean prices; the Board of Revenue reduced the amount by more than seven thousand, and Tianyan ordered Degui's family pursued for payment.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyan asked to write off inflated fodder accounts; the Board of Revenue cut more than seven thousand from the claim, and Tianyan ordered Degui's family pursued for the balance.

sentences.zh: 京口防禦高騰龍，德貴族也，與參領馬崇駿以天顏奏銷浮冒訐於將軍楊鳳翔，鳳翔格不行。

translations.literal: Jingkou garrison commander Gao Tenglong, a kinsman of Degui, together with adjutant Ma Chongjun accused Tianyan at the yamen gate of memorializing to write off inflated claims; General Yang Fengxiang blocked the case.
translations.idiomatic: Jingkou garrison commander Gao Tenglong, Degui's kinsman, and adjutant Ma Chongjun petitioned at the gate that Tianyan had written off inflated claims; General Yang Fengxiang refused to act.

sentences.zh: 總督阿席熙劾崇駿、騰龍婪取，上遣郎中圖爾宸、鍾有德會天顏勘治。

translations.literal: Governor A Xixi impeached Chongjun and Tenglong for greedy seizure; the emperor sent Directors Tu Erchen and Zhong Youde to join Tianyan in investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Governor A Xixi impeached Chongjun and Tenglong for extortion; the emperor sent Directors Tu Erchen and Zhong Youde to investigate with Tianyan.

sentences.zh: 崇駿、騰龍叩閽訟天顏奏銷浮冒，惡其訐告構罪狀，唆總督劾奏。

translations.literal: Chongjun and Tenglong petitioned at the gate, suing Tianyan for writing off inflated claims, charging that he hated their accusation and fabricated charges, and incited the governor to impeach them.
translations.idiomatic: Chongjun and Tenglong petitioned at the gate, accusing Tianyan of writing off inflated claims and of hating their whistleblowing so much that he fabricated charges and incited the governor to impeach them.

sentences.zh: 上命圖爾宸、鍾有德具獄，崇駿、騰龍婪取罪至死，天顏以草豆價戶部覈減諉罪德貴，當左遷。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Tu Erchen and Zhong Youde to complete the case. Chongjun and Tenglong were sentenced to death for greedy seizure. Tianyan, for shifting blame to Degui over the fodder prices reduced by the Board of Revenue, was to be demoted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered a full report. Chongjun and Tenglong were sentenced to death for extortion. Tianyan, for blaming Degui after the Board cut the fodder claim, was to be demoted.

sentences.zh: 得旨，如議。

translations.literal: An edict followed the recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved as recommended.

sentences.zh: 天顏將去官，疏列成勞，且言：「夙夜冰兢精白，不意遭誣訐，蒙鑑宥不加嚴譴。」

translations.literal: As Tianyan was about to leave office, he memorialized listing his achievements and said: "Day and night I have been scrupulously pure, yet unexpectedly I have met with false accusation; I am grateful for Your Majesty's discernment in not imposing severe punishment."
translations.idiomatic: On leaving office Tianyan listed his achievements and wrote: "I have served day and night with scrupulous integrity, yet I was falsely accused; I am grateful Your Majesty did not punish me severely."

sentences.zh: 上以天顏未聞有廉名，乃自言「冰兢精白」，非是，命嚴飭。

translations.literal: The emperor said Tianyan had never been known for integrity, yet he called himself "scrupulously pure"—this was wrong—and ordered him sternly admonished.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said Tianyan had never had a reputation for integrity, so to call himself "scrupulously pure" was improper, and ordered him sternly admonished.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，起湖北巡撫，复諭之曰：「爾前為巡撫，未能潔己率屬。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was recalled as governor of Hubei, and again instructed: "When you were governor before, you failed to keep yourself pure and lead your subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 23 he was recalled as governor of Hubei. The throne told him: "As governor before, you failed to keep yourself clean and set an example for your staff.

sentences.zh: 今宜痛改前非，廉謹自持，以副任使。」

translations.literal: Now you should bitterly reform past faults, hold yourself in integrity and caution, and fulfill your commission."
translations.idiomatic: Reform thoroughly, hold yourself in integrity and caution, and justify the trust placed in you."

sentences.zh: 旋移貴州。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was transferred to Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，授漕運總督，疏言：「京口至瓜洲，漕船往來，風濤最險。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was appointed director-general of grain transport and memorialized: "From Jingkou to Guazhou, where grain boats pass back and forth, the wind and waves are most dangerous.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 26 he became director-general of grain transport and reported: "Between Jingkou and Guazhou, where grain boats pass, the wind and waves are most dangerous.

sentences.zh: 請仿民間渡生船，官設十船，導引護防。」

translations.literal: I ask to follow the civilian life-saving ferries and have the government set up ten boats for guidance and protection."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the government set up ten rescue boats, like the civilian ferries, to guide and protect traffic."

sentences.zh: 部議非例，不允。

translations.literal: The ministry ruled it was not precedent and did not approve.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry said it was unprecedented and refused.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「朕南巡見京口、瓜洲往來人眾，備船過渡，有益於民。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "On my southern tour I saw the crowds crossing between Jingkou and Guazhou; providing boats for the crossing benefits the people.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "On my southern tour I saw how many people cross between Jingkou and Guazhou; ferry boats would help the people.

sentences.zh: 其如所請行。」

translations.literal: Let it be done as requested."
translations.idiomatic: Do as he asks."

sentences.zh: 天顏疏陳江南、江西累年未完漕項銀米請恩貰，上命盡免康熙十七年以前積逋。

translations.literal: Tianyan memorialized that Jiangnan and Jiangxi had for years failed to complete grain-transport silver and grain quotas and asked imperial grace; the emperor ordered full remission of arrears before the seventeenth year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyan asked grace for Jiangnan and Jiangxi grain-transport arrears; the emperor remitted all debts before Kangxi 17.

sentences.zh: 江南揚州、淮安所屬運河東瀕海諸州縣地卑下，謂之下河，頻歲被水。

translations.literal: In Jiangnan the prefectures and counties east of the Grand Canal along the sea under Yangzhou and Huai'an lie low and are called the Lower River region; year after year they suffer flooding.
translations.idiomatic: East of the Grand Canal along the coast under Yangzhou and Huai'an the land is low—called the Lower River region—and floods every few years.

sentences.zh: 上先用湯斌議，遣侍郎孫在豐疏濬下河。

translations.literal: The emperor first followed Tang Bin's proposal and sent Vice Minister Sun Zaifeng to dredge the Lower River.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor first adopted Tang Bin's plan and sent Vice Minister Sun Zaifeng to dredge the Lower River.

sentences.zh: 河道總督靳輔議起翟家壩迄高家堰築重堤，束堤堰溢出之水北出清口，謂疏濬無益。

translations.literal: Grand Canal Director Jin Fu proposed building heavy dikes from Zhujiaba to Gaojiayan to confine overflow northward through Qingkou, holding that dredging was useless.
translations.idiomatic: Canal Director Jin Fu proposed heavy dikes from Zhujiaba to Gaojiayan to channel overflow north through Qingkou, arguing dredging would not help.

sentences.zh: 天顏仍主疏濬，並修築高家堰，與不協。

translations.literal: Tianyan still advocated dredging and also repairing Gaojiayan, and they did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyan still favored dredging and repairing Gaojiayan; they clashed.

sentences.zh: 上遣尚書佛倫、熊一瀟，給事中達奇納、趙吉士會勘，佛倫等主用輔議，天顏、在豐議與輔異。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Ministers Folun and Xiong Yixiao and Secretariat Secretaries Daqina and Zhao Jishi to survey jointly. Folun and others favored Jin Fu's plan; Tianyan and Zaifeng differed from Fu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Minister Folun, Vice Minister Xiong Yixiao, and Secretaries Daqina and Zhao Jishi to inspect. Folun's party backed Jin Fu; Tianyan and Zaifeng disagreed.

sentences.zh: 天顏密疏力爭，輔疏劾天顏與在豐有連，欲在豐建功，故堅阻上游築堤。

translations.literal: Tianyan memorialized in secret, arguing forcefully. Fu memorialized impeaching Tianyan for ties with Zaifeng, saying Tianyan wanted Zaifeng to win merit and therefore stubbornly blocked diking upstream.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyan argued forcefully in a secret memorial. Fu impeached him for colluding with Zaifeng to block upstream diking so Zaifeng could claim credit.

sentences.zh: 下部議，奪天顏職，而輔亦為御史郭琇、陸祖修，給事中劉楷交章劾罷。

translations.literal: The case went to the ministries for deliberation; Tianyan was stripped of office, and Fu was also impeached in successive memorials by Censors Guo Xiu and Lu Zuxiu and Secretary Liu Kai and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: The ministries ruled: Tianyan was dismissed, and Fu was impeached in turn by Censors Guo Xiu and Lu Zuxiu and Secretary Liu Kai and removed.

sentences.zh: 初，輔請於仲家莊建閘，引駱馬湖水，別鑿中河，俾漕船避黃河之險，天顏亦議為無益。

translations.literal: Earlier Fu had asked to build a sluice at Zhongjiazhuang to draw Luoma Lake water and cut a Middle Canal so grain boats could avoid the Yellow River's dangers; Tianyan also argued it would be useless.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Fu had proposed a sluice at Zhongjiazhuang to draw Luoma Lake water and cut a Middle Canal so grain boats could avoid the Yellow River; Tianyan had called that useless too.

sentences.zh: 上命學士開音布、侍衛馬武往視，還奏天顏令漕船毋入中河，上以責天顏，逮下獄。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Academician Kaiyinbu and Guard Ma Wu to inspect; they returned reporting that Tianyan had ordered grain boats not to enter the Middle Canal. The emperor blamed Tianyan and had him imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Academician Kaiyinbu and Guard Ma Wu to inspect; they reported Tianyan had barred grain boats from the Middle Canal. The emperor blamed him and had him jailed.

sentences.zh: 天顏反覆申辨，副都御史噶爾圖舉天顏訴辭先後互異，坐奏事上書不以實論罪，上追錄天顏造舟濟師，特寬之。

translations.literal: Tianyan argued back repeatedly. Vice Censor-in-Chief Ga Ertu cited contradictions in Tianyan's statements and sentenced him for memorializing untruthfully. The emperor recalled Tianyan's building boats to ferry the army and specially showed leniency.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyan argued repeatedly. Vice Censor-in-Chief Ga Ertu noted contradictions in his testimony and convicted him of false reporting. The emperor recalled his boat-building for the Wu Sangui campaign and showed special leniency.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，卒。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi 35.

sentences.zh: 天顏歷官有惠績，嘗疏請有司虧帑雖逾限，於發遣前清償，仍貰其罪。

translations.literal: In his posts Tianyan left benevolent achievements. He once memorialized that officials with treasury shortfalls, though past the deadline, if they paid in full before exile should still be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout his career Tianyan did real good. He once asked that officials who cleared treasury debts before exile, even past the deadline, still receive pardon.

sentences.zh: 獄囚因逸犯株連，待質已三年者，於秋審時開釋；

translations.literal: Prisoners implicated through fugitive offenders and held awaiting trial for three years were released at the autumn assizes;
translations.idiomatic: Prisoners held three years awaiting trial because a fugitive had implicated them were released at the autumn assizes;

sentences.zh: 獄囚無親屬饋食，月給米三斗：皆卹下之政。

translations.literal: prisoners without kin to bring food were given three dou of rice per month—all policies to comfort the people below.
translations.idiomatic: and prisoners without families to feed them received three dou of rice a month—all measures to ease hardship below.

sentences.zh: 在江南，興水利，蠲積逋，而請免縴夫，甦一時之困，江南民尤頌之。

translations.literal: In Jiangnan he promoted waterworks, remitted arrears, and asked to abolish tracking labor, relieving a moment's distress; the people of Jiangnan especially praised him.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiangnan he promoted waterworks, remitted arrears, and abolished tracking labor, easing immediate distress; the people there especially praised him.

sentences.zh: 獨劾嘉定知縣陸隴其不協於輿論，左都御史魏象樞疏言：「天顏劾隴其，稱其操守絕一塵，德有餘而才不足。

translations.literal: Only in impeaching Jiading Magistrate Lu Longqi did he run against public opinion. Censor-in-Chief Wei Xiangshu memorialized: "Tianyan impeached Longqi yet praised his integrity as spotless, his virtue more than sufficient though his talent was not.
translations.idiomatic: Only his impeachment of Jiading Magistrate Lu Longqi went against public opinion. Censor-in-Chief Wei Xiangshu wrote: "Tianyan impeached Longqi yet called his integrity spotless and his virtue ample though his talent was limited.

sentences.zh: 今之有司，惟操守為難；

translations.literal: Among officials today, integrity alone is hard;
translations.idiomatic: Among officials today, integrity is the hardest thing;

sentences.zh: 既知之矣，何不留以長養百姓？

translations.literal: knowing this, why not keep him to nurture the people long?
translations.idiomatic: knowing this, why not keep him to serve the people?

sentences.zh: 請嚴飭諸督撫大破積習，勿使廉吏灰心，貪風日長。」

translations.literal: I ask that governors and governors-general be sternly admonished to break deep-seated habits, lest honest officials lose heart and greed grow daily."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that governors be sternly warned to break old habits, lest honest men lose heart and corruption spread."

sentences.zh: 會詔舉清廉，象樞遂以隴其應，語具隴其傳。

translations.literal: At that time an edict called for recommending the incorrupt; Xiangshu then nominated Longqi—the account is given in Longqi's biography.
translations.idiomatic: When an edict called for nominations of honest officials, Xiangshu nominated Longqi; the full account is in Longqi's biography.

sentences.zh: 阿山，伊拉哩氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人。

translations.literal: A Shan, of the Irarai clan, was a Bannerman of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: A Shan, of the Irarai clan, belonged to the Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 初自吏部筆帖式歷刑部主事、戶部員外部。

translations.literal: He began as a clerk in the Board of Personnel and rose through secretary in the Board of Punishments to department director in the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from a clerk in the Board of Personnel through secretary in the Board of Punishments to department director in the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 康熙十八年，授翰林院侍講，七遷至戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Kangxi he was made Hanlin expositor and was promoted seven times to vice minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 18 he became a Hanlin expositor and was promoted seven times to vice minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 三十年，命治賑西安、鳳翔二府，明年還京。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was ordered to manage relief in the prefectures of Xi'an and Fengxiang; the next year he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 30 he was sent to manage famine relief in Xi'an and Fengxiang; he returned to Beijing the next year.

sentences.zh: 上聞流民有至襄陽者，以問阿山。

translations.literal: The emperor heard that refugees had reached Xiangyang and questioned A Shan.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that refugees had reached Xiangyang, the emperor questioned A Shan.

sentences.zh: 阿山言正月已得雪，民無流亡。

translations.literal: A Shan said snow had already fallen in the first month and the people were not fleeing.
translations.idiomatic: A Shan said snow had fallen in the first month and there was no flight of the people.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「正月雖雪，二、三月雨不時，麥收未可望。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Though there was snow in the first month, in the second and third months the rains were untimely and the wheat harvest cannot be hoped for.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Snow in the first month does not change that the second and third months brought untimely rain and a poor wheat harvest.

sentences.zh: 流民至襄陽甚多，汝未之知耳。」

translations.literal: Refugees reaching Xiangyang are very numerous—you did not know."
translations.idiomatic: Many refugees have reached Xiangyang—you simply did not know."

sentences.zh: 坐奉使不盡心，左授郎中。

translations.literal: For failure to serve his commission wholeheartedly, he was demoted to director.
translations.idiomatic: For neglecting his mission he was demoted to director.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，擢左副都御史。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year he was promoted to vice censor-in-chief on the left.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 33 he was made vice censor-in-chief on the left.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上親征噶爾丹，阿山從。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the emperor campaigned in person against Galdan; A Shan followed.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 35 the emperor campaigned in person against Galdan; A Shan accompanied him.

sentences.zh: 授阿密達為將軍，逐噶爾丹，阿山為參贊。

translations.literal: Amida was made general to pursue Galdan, with A Shan as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Amida was appointed general to pursue Galdan, with A Shan as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 師還，授盛京禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was made vice minister of rites at Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: After the campaign he became vice minister of rites at Mukden.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，授翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he was made chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 36 he became chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，授江南江西總督。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year he was appointed governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 39 he was made governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 安徽布政使張四教以憂去官，巡撫高永爵劾四教擅動庫帑，下阿山察奏。

translations.literal: Anhui Provincial Treasurer Zhang Sijiao left office on mourning; Governor Gao Yongjue impeached Sijiao for unauthorized use of treasury funds, and the case was sent to A Shan for investigation and report.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui Treasurer Zhang Sijiao left on mourning leave; Governor Gao Yongjue impeached him for unauthorized use of treasury funds, and A Shan was ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 阿山言四教動庫帑為公用，請免議，上復命具實狀以聞。

translations.literal: A Shan said Sijiao had used the treasury for public purposes and asked that the case be dropped; the emperor again ordered a full factual report.
translations.idiomatic: A Shan said Sijiao had used the funds for public business and asked that charges be dropped; the emperor ordered a full factual report.

sentences.zh: 阿山乃言：「三十八年上南巡，四教發庫帑十一萬供辦，議令各官扣俸抵補。

translations.literal: A Shan then said: "In the thirty-eighth year, when Your Majesty toured the south, Sijiao disbursed one hundred ten thousand from the treasury for arrangements; it was agreed that each official would make up the sum by salary deductions.
translations.idiomatic: A Shan then reported: "In Kangxi 38, during Your Majesty's southern tour, Sijiao spent one hundred ten thousand taels from the treasury on arrangements; officials agreed to repay it from their salaries.

sentences.zh: 各官皆自承，臣不敢隱。」

translations.literal: Each official has admitted it himself; your servant dares not conceal it."
translations.idiomatic: Each official has admitted as much; I dare not conceal it."

sentences.zh: 上責阿山徇情沽譽，命漕運總督桑額鞫四教，論如律。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked A Shan for favoritism and seeking reputation, ordered Grain Transport Director Sang E to try Sijiao, and sentenced him according to law.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked A Shan for favoritism and ordered Transport Director Sang E to try Sijiao, who was sentenced under the law.

sentences.zh: 阿山當奪職，上寬之，命留任。

translations.literal: A Shan should have been stripped of office; the emperor showed leniency and ordered him to remain.
translations.idiomatic: A Shan should have been dismissed; the emperor spared him and ordered him to remain in office.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，阿山劾江西巡撫張志棟大計不公，志棟及布政使李興祖、按察使劉廷璣、道員韓象起等皆奪職。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year A Shan impeached Jiangxi Governor Zhang Zhidong for unfair grand evaluation; Zhidong and Provincial Treasurer Li Xingzu, Provincial Judge Liu Tingji, Circuit Intendant Han Xiangqi, and others were all stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 43 A Shan impeached Jiangxi Governor Zhang Zhidong for rigging the grand evaluation; Zhidong, Treasurer Li Xingzu, Judge Liu Tingji, Intendant Han Xiangqi, and others were all dismissed.

sentences.zh: 阿山又言大計志棟主之，請復興祖等官。

translations.literal: A Shan also said the evaluation had been Zhidong's doing and asked that Xingzu and the others be restored.
translations.idiomatic: A Shan then said Zhidong had controlled the evaluation and asked that Xingzu and the others be reinstated.

sentences.zh: 給事中許志進劾阿山恩威自擅，阿山疏辯，且詆志進為淮安漕標營卒子，素行不端，為志棟報復。

translations.literal: Secretary Xu Zhijin impeached A Shan for arrogating reward and punishment. A Shan memorialized in defense and also slandered Zhijin as the son of a Huai'an grain-transport garrison soldier, of habitual misconduct, acting in revenge for Zhidong.
translations.idiomatic: Secretary Xu Zhijin impeached A Shan for arrogating reward and punishment. A Shan defended himself and smeared Zhijin as the son of a Huai'an transport garrison soldier, habitually corrupt, acting in revenge for Zhidong.

sentences.zh: 志進亦追論阿山庇張四教，並收屬吏賄賂，盜倉穀不問，貪婬惡跡，縱妾父生事。

translations.literal: Zhijin also pursued charges that A Shan had shielded Zhang Sijiao, accepted bribes from subordinates, ignored theft of granary grain, and committed greedy and licentious acts, indulging his concubine's father in troublemaking.
translations.idiomatic: Zhijin countered that A Shan had shielded Zhang Sijiao, taken bribes from subordinates, ignored granary theft, and indulged greed, lust, and his concubine's father's abuses.

sentences.zh: 疏並下部議，部議皆奪職。

translations.literal: The memorials were sent together to the ministries for deliberation; the ministries ruled both should be stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Both memorials went to the ministries, which ruled both men should be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 上复寬阿山，命留任如故。

translations.literal: The emperor again showed leniency to A Shan and ordered him to remain as before.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again spared A Shan and left him in office.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，疏劾江寧知府陳鵬年貪酷，並以妓樓改建講堂，凟聖諭，大不敬。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year he memorialized impeaching Jiangning Prefect Chen Pengnian for greed and cruelty, and also for converting a brothel into a lecture hall, profaning the sage's teaching—great irreverence.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 44 he impeached Jiangning Prefect Chen Pengnian for greed and cruelty, and for converting a brothel into a lecture hall—profaning the sage's teaching, a grave offense.

sentences.zh: 命會桑額及河道總督張鵬翮集讞，坐鵬年罪至斬，上特命來京，事具鵬年傳。

translations.literal: He was ordered to join Sang E and Grand Canal Director Zhang Penghe in judgment; Pengnian was sentenced up to execution, but the emperor specially ordered him brought to the capital—the account is given in Pengnian's biography.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to join Sang E and Canal Director Zhang Penghe in judgment; Pengnian was sentenced to death, but the emperor ordered him brought to Beijing instead—the full account is in Pengnian's biography.

sentences.zh: 阿山與桑額、鵬翮議自泗州開河築堤，引淮水至黃家堰，入張福口，會出清口，是為溜淮套，疏請上臨視。

translations.literal: A Shan, together with Sang E and Penghe, proposed opening a canal and building dikes from Sizhou to draw Huai River water to Huangjiayan, entering Zhangfukou and joining Qingkou—called the Liuhuaitao project—and memorialized asking the emperor to inspect in person.
translations.idiomatic: A Shan, Sang E, and Penghe proposed a canal and dikes from Sizhou to channel Huai water to Huangjiayan, through Zhangfukou to Qingkou—the Liuhuaitao project—and asked the emperor to inspect it in person.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，授刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year he was appointed minister of punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 45 he became minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，上南巡，臨視溜淮套，諭曰：「阿山等奏溜淮套別開一河，分洩淮水，繪圖進呈。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year, on the southern tour, the emperor inspected the Liuhuaitao site and instructed: "A Shan and others memorialized that the Liuhuaitao would open a separate river to divert Huai water and submitted drawings.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 46, on his southern tour, the emperor inspected Liuhuaitao and said: "A Shan and others proposed opening a separate channel to divert Huai water and submitted drawings.

sentences.zh: 朕策騎自清口至曹家廟，見地勢甚高，雖成河，不能直達清口，與所進圖不同。

translations.literal: I rode from Qingkou to Caojiamiao and saw the terrain is very high; even if a river were made, it could not reach Qingkou directly, unlike the submitted map.
translations.idiomatic: I rode from Qingkou to Caojiamiao and found the ground too high; even with a canal it could not reach Qingkou as drawn.

sentences.zh: 且所立標竿多在民塚上，朕何忍發此無限枯骨耶？」

translations.literal: Moreover the survey stakes stand mostly on commoners' graves—how can I bear to disturb these countless dead bones?"
translations.idiomatic: And the survey stakes stand on people's graves—how can I disturb so many dead?"

sentences.zh: 命鵬翮罷其事。

translations.literal: He ordered Penghe to abandon the project.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Penghe to abandon the project.

sentences.zh: 下九卿議，阿山及桑額、鵬翮皆奪職；

translations.literal: The case went to the Nine Ministers for deliberation; A Shan, Sang E, and Penghe were all to be stripped of office;
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Ministers ruled that A Shan, Sang E, and Penghe should all be dismissed;

sentences.zh: 上以阿山主其議，命但坐阿山，遂奪職。

translations.literal: the emperor, since A Shan had led the proposal, ordered only A Shan punished, and he was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: but since A Shan had led the proposal, the emperor punished only him and stripped him of office.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，江蘇布政使宜思恭以虧帑坐譴，因列訴總督噶禮等頻向需索，阿山亦受節餽，下部議，上以阿山老，寬之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year Jiangsu Provincial Treasurer Yi Sigong was punished for a treasury shortfall and listed repeated demands from Governor-General Ga Li and others; A Shan had also accepted seasonal gifts. The case went to the ministries; the emperor, considering A Shan old, showed leniency.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 51 Jiangsu Treasurer Yi Sigong was punished for a treasury shortfall and accused Governor-General Ga Li and others of repeated extortion; A Shan had also accepted gifts. The ministries deliberated, but the emperor spared him because of his age.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，萬壽，復原品。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year, at the imperial birthday celebration, his original rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 52, at the imperial birthday celebration, his original rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 逾年，卒。

translations.literal: The year after, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died the following year.

sentences.zh: 阿山故精察，上嘗問大學士李光地：「阿山在官何若？」

translations.literal: A Shan had always been sharp and observant. The emperor once asked Grand Secretary Li Guangdi: "How is A Shan in office?"
translations.idiomatic: A Shan had always been sharp-eyed. The emperor once asked Grand Secretary Li Guangdi: "How is A Shan as an official?"

sentences.zh: 光地奏：「臣嘗與同僚，廉幹，果於任事。

translations.literal: Guangdi replied: "Your servant once served with him. He is incorrupt and capable, bold in handling affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdi replied: "I once served with him. He is honest and capable, and bold in action.

sentences.zh: 其失民心，獨劾陳鵬年一事耳。」

translations.literal: His loss of popular support was only in the matter of impeaching Chen Pengnian."
translations.idiomatic: He lost popular support only over impeaching Chen Pengnian."

sentences.zh: 上頷之。

translations.literal: The emperor nodded assent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor nodded in agreement.

sentences.zh: 噶禮，棟鄂氏，滿洲正紅旗人，何和哩四世孫也。

translations.literal: Ga Li, of the Donggo clan, was a Bannerman of the Plain Red Banner and a fourth-generation descendant of Heheli.
translations.idiomatic: Ga Li, of the Donggo clan, belonged to the Plain Red Banner and was a fourth-generation descendant of Heheli.

sentences.zh: 自廕生授吏部主事，再遷郎中。

translations.literal: Through hereditary privilege he was made secretary in the Board of Personnel and was twice promoted to director.
translations.idiomatic: Through hereditary privilege he became a secretary in the Board of Personnel and was twice promoted to director.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十五年，上親征噶爾丹，次克魯倫河。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year of Kangxi the emperor campaigned in person against Galdan and halted at the Kerulen River.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 35 the emperor campaigned in person against Galdan and halted at the Kerulen River.

sentences.zh: 噶禮從左都御史於成龍督運中路兵糧，首達行在，召對，當上意。

translations.literal: Ga Li followed Censor-in-Chief Yu Chenglong in supervising grain transport for the central route, was first to reach the imperial camp, was summoned for audience, and pleased the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Ga Li followed Censor-in-Chief Yu Chenglong in supplying the central route, was first to reach the imperial camp, was summoned to audience, and pleased the emperor.

sentences.zh: 尋擢盛京戶部理事官。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was promoted to commissioner of the Mukden Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he became commissioner of the Mukden Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 歲餘三遷，授內閣學士。

translations.literal: Within a year he was promoted three times and made a Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: Within a year he was promoted three times and made a Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，授山西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year he was appointed governor of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 38 he was made governor of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 噶禮當官勤敏能治事，然貪甚，縱吏虐民。

translations.literal: Ga Li in office was diligent, sharp, and able to handle affairs, yet he was very greedy and indulged clerks in oppressing the people.
translations.idiomatic: Ga Li was diligent and capable in office, but extremely greedy and let his clerks oppress the people.

sentences.zh: 撫山西數年，山西民不能堪。

translations.literal: After governing Shanxi several years, the people of Shanxi could not endure it.
translations.idiomatic: After several years governing Shanxi, the people could not endure him.

sentences.zh: 會潞安知府缺員，噶禮疏薦霍州知州李紹祖，紹祖使酒自刎，噶禮匿不以奏。

translations.literal: When the Lu'an prefecture post fell vacant, Ga Li memorialized recommending Huozhou Magistrate Li Shaozu; Shaozu, drunk, cut his own throat, and Ga Li concealed it without reporting.
translations.idiomatic: When the Lu'an prefecture fell vacant, Ga Li recommended Huozhou Magistrate Li Shaozu; Shaozu, drunk, killed himself, and Ga Li concealed it without reporting.

sentences.zh: 上聞之，下九卿議罪，擬奪噶禮職，上寬之。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard, the case went to the Nine Ministers for sentencing; they proposed stripping Ga Li of office, but the emperor showed leniency.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor learned of it, the Nine Ministers proposed dismissing Ga Li, but the emperor spared him.

sentences.zh: 御史劉若鼐疏論噶禮貪，得贓無慮數十萬，太原知府趙鳳詔為其腹心，專用酷刑以濟貪壑事。

translations.literal: Censor Liu Ruonai memorialized that Ga Li was corrupt, having taken bribes of no less than several hundred thousand, and that Taiyuan Prefect Zhao Fengzhao was his intimate, using cruel punishments alone to fill his greedy maw.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Liu Ruonai charged that Ga Li was corrupt, having taken bribes of hundreds of thousands, with Taiyuan Prefect Zhao Fengzhao as his henchman using torture to feed his greed.

sentences.zh: 下噶禮復奏，得辨釋。

translations.literal: Ga Li was ordered to reply; he defended himself and was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Ga Li was ordered to respond and cleared himself.

sentences.zh: 平遙民郭明奇等以噶禮庇貪婪知縣王綬，走京師詣巡城御史袁橋列訴。

translations.literal: Commoners of Pingyao, Guo Mingqi and others, because Ga Li shielded the greedy magistrate Wang Shou, went to the capital and laid their complaints before City Patrol Censor Yuan Qiao.
translations.idiomatic: Pingyao commoners Guo Mingqi and others, because Ga Li had shielded the corrupt magistrate Wang Shou, went to Beijing and petitioned City Patrol Censor Yuan Qiao.

sentences.zh: 橋疏聞，並言「噶禮通省錢糧加火耗十之二，分補大同、臨汾等縣虧帑，餘並以入己，得四十餘萬；

translations.literal: Qiao memorialized reporting this and also said: "Ga Li added two-tenths surcharge on provincial land tax and grain throughout the province, using part to cover shortfalls in Datong, Linfen, and other counties and keeping the rest for himself, amounting to more than four hundred thousand;
translations.idiomatic: Qiao reported the case and charged that "Ga Li had added a twenty-percent surcharge on provincial taxes, using part to cover county shortfalls in Datong and Linfen and keeping more than four hundred thousand for himself;

sentences.zh: 指修解州祠宇，用巡撫印簿勒捐；

translations.literal: citing repair of the Xiezhou temple, he used the governor's seal register to force donations;
translations.idiomatic: under the pretext of repairing the Xiezhou temple, he used the governor's seal register to force donations;

sentences.zh: 令家伶赴平陽、汾州、潞安三府迫富民饋遺；

translations.literal: he sent household actors to the three prefectures of Pingyang, Fenzhou, and Lu'an to extort gifts from wealthy families;
translations.idiomatic: he sent household actors to Pingyang, Fenzhou, and Lu'an to extort gifts from wealthy families;

sentences.zh: 又以訟得臨汾、介休富民亢時鼎、梁湄金；

translations.literal: through lawsuits he obtained gold from the wealthy men Kang Shiding of Linfen and Liang Mei of Jiexiu;
translations.idiomatic: through lawsuits he obtained gold from wealthy men Kang Shiding of Linfen and Liang Mei of Jiexiu;

sentences.zh: 縱汾州同知馬遴；

translations.literal: he indulged Fenzhou Subprefect Ma Lin;
translations.idiomatic: he indulged Fenzhou Subprefect Ma Lin;

sentences.zh: 庇洪洞知縣杜連登，皆貪吏；

translations.literal: he shielded Hongtong Magistrate Du Liandeng—all corrupt officials;
translations.idiomatic: he shielded Hongtong Magistrate Du Liandeng—all corrupt officials;

sentences.zh: 隱平定雹災」，凡七事。

translations.literal: he concealed the hail disaster in Pingding"—seven charges in all.
translations.idiomatic: he concealed the hail disaster in Pingding"—seven charges in all.

sentences.zh: 上命噶禮復奏，山西學政鄒士聰代太原士民疏留噶禮。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Ga Li to reply. Shanxi Education Commissioner Zou Shicong memorialized on behalf of Taiyuan gentry and commoners asking that Ga Li be retained.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Ga Li to respond. Shanxi Education Commissioner Zou Shicong petitioned on behalf of Taiyuan gentry and commoners to retain Ga Li.

sentences.zh: 御史蔡珍疏劾士璁「職在衡文，乃與巡撫朋比。

translations.literal: Censor Cai Zhen memorialized impeaching Zou Shicong: "His duty is to evaluate literature, yet he factions with the governor.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Cai Zhen impeached Zou Shicong: "His duty is to examine candidates, yet he factions with the governor.

sentences.zh: 且袁橋疏得旨二日後，太原士民即具呈，顯為誣偽。

translations.literal: Moreover, two days after Yuan Qiao's memorial received imperial response, Taiyuan gentry and commoners already submitted a petition—clearly a fabricated fraud.
translations.idiomatic: Two days after Yuan Qiao's memorial received a response, Taiyuan's petition was already ready—clearly fabricated.

sentences.zh: 噶禮與士璁同城，委為不知，是昏憒也；

translations.literal: Ga Li and Zou Shicong are in the same city; to plead ignorance is stupidity;
translations.idiomatic: Ga Li and Zou Shicong share the same city; to plead ignorance is stupidity;

sentences.zh: 知而不阻，是幸恩也。

translations.literal: to know and not stop it is to presume on favor.
translations.idiomatic: to know and not stop it is to presume on imperial favor.

sentences.zh: 請並敕部議處」。

translations.literal: I ask that both be referred to the ministries for punishment."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that both be referred to the ministries for punishment."

sentences.zh: 尋噶禮復奏，以明奇等屢坐事走京師誣告，並辨橋、珍所言皆無據。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward Ga Li replied that Mingqi and others, repeatedly convicted, had fled to the capital to lodge false accusations, and rebutted Qiao's and Zhen's statements as all groundless.
translations.idiomatic: Ga Li soon replied that Mingqi and others, repeatedly convicted, had fled to Beijing to lodge false charges, and rebutted Qiao and Zhen as groundless.

sentences.zh: 下九卿察奏，明奇等下刑部治罪，橋、珍坐誣譴罷。

translations.literal: The case went to the Nine Ministers for investigation and report; Mingqi and others were sent to the Board of Punishments for punishment, and Qiao and Zhen were dismissed for false accusation.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Ministers investigated: Mingqi and others were sent to the Board of Punishments, and Qiao and Zhen were dismissed for false accusation.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，遷戶部侍郎，旋擢江南江西總督。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year he was transferred to vice minister of revenue and soon promoted to governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 48 he became vice minister of revenue and soon governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 噶禮至江南，益恣肆，累疏劾江蘇巡撫於準、布政使宜思恭、按察使焦映漢，皆坐罷。

translations.literal: When Ga Li reached Jiangnan he grew still more unrestrained, repeatedly memorializing impeachments of Jiangsu Governor Yu Zhun, Provincial Treasurer Yi Sigong, and Provincial Judge Jiao Yinghan—all were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiangnan Ga Li grew more unrestrained still, impeaching Jiangsu Governor Yu Zhun, Treasurer Yi Sigong, and Judge Jiao Yinghan until all were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 知府陳鵬年初為總督阿山劾罷，上復命守蘇州；

translations.literal: Prefect Chen Pengnian had first been impeached and dismissed by Governor-General A Shan; the emperor again ordered him to hold Suzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Chen Pengnian had first been impeached and dismissed by Governor-General A Shan; the emperor restored him to Suzhou;

sentences.zh: 及宜思恭罷，署布政使。

translations.literal: when Yi Sigong was dismissed, he acted as provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: and when Yi Sigong was dismissed, he acted as provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 鵬年素伉直，忤噶禮。

translations.literal: Pengnian had always been upright and outspoken and offended Ga Li.
translations.idiomatic: Pengnian had always been upright and outspoken and clashed with Ga Li.

sentences.zh: 噶禮續劾宜思恭虧帑，又論糧道賈樸建關開河皆有所侵蝕，遂及鵬年覈報不實，鵬年復坐罷。

translations.literal: Ga Li continued impeaching Yi Sigong for treasury shortfalls, also charging Grain Intendant Jia Pu with embezzlement in building sluices and opening canals, and extending the charge to Pengnian for false verification reports; Pengnian was again dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Ga Li continued impeaching Yi Sigong for treasury shortfalls, charged Grain Intendant Jia Pu with embezzling on canal works, and extended the charge to Pengnian for false verification; Pengnian was dismissed again.

sentences.zh: 噶禮复密疏鵬年虎丘詩怨望，上不為動。

translations.literal: Ga Li also sent a secret memorial that Pengnian's Tiger Hill poem showed resentment; the emperor was unmoved.
translations.idiomatic: Ga Li also sent a secret memorial claiming Pengnian's Tiger Hill poem showed resentment; the emperor was unmoved.

sentences.zh: 巡撫張伯行有廉聲，至則又與噶禮忤。

translations.literal: Governor Zhang Boxing had a reputation for integrity; when he arrived he again clashed with Ga Li.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Zhang Boxing had a reputation for integrity; when he arrived he clashed with Ga Li again.

sentences.zh: 五十年，伯行疏言本科江南鄉試取士不協輿論，正考官副都御史左必蕃亦檢舉同考官知縣王曰俞、方名所薦士有不通文字者。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year Boxing memorialized that this year's Jiangnan provincial examination selections did not accord with public opinion; chief examiner Vice Censor-in-Chief Zuo Bifan also reported that associate examiners Magistrates Wang Yueyu and Fang Ming had recommended candidates who could not handle written characters.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 50 Boxing reported that the Jiangnan provincial examination selections did not match public opinion; chief examiner Vice Censor-in-Chief Zuo Bifan also reported that associate examiners Magistrates Wang Yueyu and Fang Ming had recommended candidates who could barely write.

sentences.zh: 上命尚書張鵬翮如揚州會噶禮及伯行察審。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Minister Zhang Penghe to go to Yangzhou to join Ga Li and Boxing in investigation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Minister Zhang Penghe to Yangzhou to investigate with Ga Li and Boxing.

sentences.zh: 鵬翮至，會讞，既得副考官編修趙晉及曰俞、名諸交通狀，伯行欲窮其獄。

translations.literal: When Penghe arrived, they held joint judgment; once the bribery dealings of associate examiner Compiler Zhao Jin and Yueyu, Ming, and others were established, Boxing wished to pursue the case to the end.
translations.idiomatic: When Penghe arrived they held a joint hearing; once bribery by associate examiner Compiler Zhao Jin, Yueyu, Ming, and others was established, Boxing wanted to pursue the case fully.

sentences.zh: 噶禮盛怒，刑證人，遂罷讞。

translations.literal: Ga Li was furious, tortured witnesses, and the hearing was adjourned.
translations.idiomatic: Ga Li flew into a rage, tortured witnesses, and the hearing was adjourned.

sentences.zh: 伯行乃劾噶禮，謂輿論盛傳總督與監臨提調交通鬻舉人；

translations.literal: Boxing then impeached Ga Li, saying public opinion widely held that the governor-general and the supervising examiner had traded in candidates through bribery;
translations.idiomatic: Boxing then impeached Ga Li, saying public opinion held that the governor-general and supervising examiner had sold degrees through bribery;

sentences.zh: 及事發，又傳總督索銀五十萬，許不竟其事：請敕解任就讞。

translations.literal: and when the affair broke, it was further said the governor-general had demanded five hundred thousand taels of silver and promised not to pursue the matter to the end: he asked that Ga Li be ordered relieved and tried on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: and when the scandal broke, rumor said the governor-general had demanded five hundred thousand taels and promised to drop the case: he asked that Ga Li be relieved and tried on the spot.

sentences.zh: 噶禮亦劾伯行，謂：「方會讞時，臣正鞫囚，伯行謂臣言不當，臣恐爭論失體，緘口結舌。

translations.literal: Ga Li also impeached Boxing, saying: "During the joint hearing I was interrogating a prisoner when Boxing said my words were improper; fearing argument would lose decorum, I held my tongue.
translations.idiomatic: Ga Li also impeached Boxing, saying: "During the hearing I was interrogating a prisoner when Boxing challenged my words; fearing an undignified quarrel, I held my tongue.

sentences.zh: 伯行遂陰謀誣陷，以鬻舉人得銀五十萬汙臣，臣不能與俱生。」

translations.literal: Boxing then plotted in secret to frame me, defiling me with the charge of selling degrees for five hundred thousand taels; I cannot live together with such a man."
translations.idiomatic: Boxing then plotted to frame me, charging that I sold degrees for five hundred thousand taels; I cannot share the world with such a man."

sentences.zh: 因及伯行專事著書，猜忌糊塗，不能清理案牘。

translations.literal: He also charged that Boxing devoted himself to writing books, was suspicious and muddled, and could not clear his case files.
translations.idiomatic: He also charged that Boxing devoted himself to books, was suspicious and muddled, and could not manage his paperwork.

sentences.zh: 時方有戴名世之獄，又言：「南山集刻板在蘇州印行，伯行豈得不知？

translations.literal: At that time the Dai Mingshi case was active, and he further said: "The woodblocks of Nanshan Ji were printed in Suzhou—could Boxing not have known?
translations.idiomatic: At the time of the Dai Mingshi case, he added: "The woodblocks of Nanshan Ji were printed in Suzhou—could Boxing not have known?

sentences.zh: 進士方苞以作序連坐，伯行夙與友，不肯捕治。」

translations.literal: Jinshi Fang Bao was implicated for writing a preface; Boxing had long been his friend and refused to arrest him."
translations.idiomatic: Jinshi Fang Bao was implicated for writing a preface; Boxing had long been his friend and refused to arrest him."

sentences.zh: 並羅列伯行不職數事。

translations.literal: He also listed several counts of Boxing's dereliction of duty.
translations.idiomatic: He also listed several counts of Boxing's dereliction of duty.

sentences.zh: 疏入，上並命解任，令鵬翮會漕運總督赫壽察奏。

translations.literal: When the memorials arrived, the emperor ordered both relieved of duty and directed Penghe to join Grain Transport Director He Shou in investigation and report.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorials arrived, the emperor relieved both men and ordered Penghe and Transport Director He Shou to investigate.

sentences.zh: 獄具，晉、曰俞、名及所取士交通得賄，當科場舞弊律論罪；

translations.literal: The case was concluded: Jin, Yueyu, Ming, and the candidates they had taken were found to have traded in bribery and were sentenced under the statute on examination fraud;
translations.idiomatic: The case concluded: Jin, Yueyu, Ming, and their candidates were convicted of bribery under the examination-fraud statute;

sentences.zh: 噶禮劾伯行不能清理案牘事實，餘皆督撫會銜題諮舊事，苞為伯行逮送刑部，南山集刻板在江寧，皆免議；

translations.literal: Ga Li's charge that Boxing could not clear his case files was found factual; the rest were old matters jointly reported by governor-generals and governors; Bao was arrested by Boxing and sent to the Board of Punishments; the Nanshan Ji blocks were in Jiangning—all were exempted from discussion;
translations.idiomatic: Ga Li's charge that Boxing could not manage paperwork was upheld; the rest were old joint reports by governors; Bao was sent to the Board of Punishments; the Nanshan Ji blocks were in Jiangning—all were dropped;

sentences.zh: 伯行妄奏噶禮鬻舉人，當奪職。

translations.literal: Boxing had falsely memorialized that Ga Li sold degrees and should be stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Boxing was to be dismissed for falsely charging Ga Li with selling degrees.

sentences.zh: 上切責鵬翮、赫壽瞻徇，又命尚書穆和倫、張廷樞覆讞，仍如鵬翮等議。

translations.literal: The emperor sharply rebuked Penghe and He Shou for favoritism, then ordered Ministers Mu Helun and Zhang Tingshu to rehear the case; they still followed Penghe's recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sharply rebuked Penghe and He Shou for favoritism, then ordered Ministers Mu Helun and Zhang Tingshu to rehear the case; they still followed Penghe's line.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「噶禮才有餘，治事敏練，而性喜生事，屢疏劾伯行。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Ga Li has talent to spare and is quick and skilled in handling affairs, but by nature he loves to stir trouble and has repeatedly memorialized against Boxing.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Ga Li is talented and efficient, but he loves to stir trouble and has repeatedly impeached Boxing.

sentences.zh: 朕以伯行操守為天下第一，手批不淮。

translations.literal: I hold Boxing's integrity to be the finest in the realm and have personally annotated his memorials not approved.
translations.idiomatic: I consider Boxing's integrity the finest in the realm and have personally rejected those memorials.

sentences.zh: 此議是非顛倒！」

translations.literal: This finding reverses right and wrong!"
translations.idiomatic: This finding reverses right and wrong!"

sentences.zh: 下九卿、詹事、科道察奏，复諭曰：「噶禮操守，朕不能信；

translations.literal: The case went to the Nine Ministers, Court of Imperial Studies, and Secretariat and Censorate for investigation and report. He instructed again: "I cannot trust Ga Li's integrity;
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Ministers, Court of Imperial Studies, and censorate investigated. He said again: "I cannot trust Ga Li's integrity;

sentences.zh: 若無張伯行，江南必受其朘削且半矣。

translations.literal: without Zhang Boxing, Jiangnan would surely have been drained by him of at least half its wealth.
translations.idiomatic: without Zhang Boxing, Jiangnan would have been drained of at least half its wealth.

sentences.zh: 即如陳鵬年稍有聲譽，噶禮欲害之，摘虎丘詩有悖謬語，朕閱其詩，初無他意。

translations.literal: Even Chen Pengnian, who had some reputation, Ga Li wished to harm; he picked out the Tiger Hill poem for irreverent words—I read the poem and at first saw no other intent.
translations.idiomatic: Even Chen Pengnian, who had some reputation, Ga Li tried to ruin by seizing on irreverent words in his Tiger Hill poem—I read the poem and saw no ill intent.

sentences.zh: 又劾中軍副將李麟騎射皆劣。

translations.literal: He also impeached Central Army Vice Commander Li Lin for poor horsemanship and archery.
translations.idiomatic: He also impeached Central Army Vice Commander Li Lin for poor horsemanship and archery.

sentences.zh: 麟比來迎駕，朕試以騎射，俱優。

translations.literal: Lin recently came to welcome the imperial progress; I tested his riding and archery and found both excellent.
translations.idiomatic: Lin recently came to welcome me; I tested his riding and archery and found both excellent.

sentences.zh: 若令噶禮與較，定不能及。

translations.literal: If Ga Li were made to compete with him, he certainly could not match.
translations.idiomatic: Ga Li could certainly not match him in a contest.

sentences.zh: 朕於是心疑噶禮矣。

translations.literal: At this I began to doubt Ga Li in my heart.
translations.idiomatic: At that point I began to doubt Ga Li.

sentences.zh: 互劾之案，遣大臣往讞，為噶禮所製。

translations.literal: The mutual impeachment case, when ministers were sent to judge it, was manipulated by Ga Li.
translations.idiomatic: The mutual impeachment case, when ministers were sent to judge it, was manipulated by Ga Li.

sentences.zh: 爾等皆能體朕保全廉吏之心，使正人無所疑懼，則海宇蒙昇平之福矣。」

translations.literal: If you all can embody my heart in preserving honest officials, so that upright men have no doubt or fear, then the realm will enjoy the blessing of peace."
translations.idiomatic: If you all share my wish to protect honest officials so upright men need not fear, the realm will enjoy true peace."

sentences.zh: 九卿等議噶禮與伯行同任封疆，互劾失大臣禮，皆奪職；

translations.literal: The Nine Ministers ruled that Ga Li and Boxing, sharing frontier responsibility, had lost the decorum of great ministers in mutual impeachment and both should be stripped of office;
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Ministers ruled that Ga Li and Boxing, sharing frontier responsibility, had violated ministerial decorum in mutual impeachment and both should be dismissed;

sentences.zh: 上命留伯行任，噶禮如議奪職。

translations.literal: the emperor ordered Boxing retained in office and Ga Li dismissed as recommended.
translations.idiomatic: the emperor kept Boxing in office and dismissed Ga Li as recommended.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，噶禮母叩閽，言噶禮與弟色勒奇、子幹都置毒食物中謀弒母，噶禮妻以別戶子幹泰為子，縱令糾眾毀屋。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year Ga Li's mother petitioned at the gate, saying Ga Li with his brother Seleqi and son Gandu had put poison in food plotting to murder her; Ga Li's wife had taken a son from another household, Gantai, as her own and incited a mob to destroy the house.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 53 Ga Li's mother petitioned at the gate, charging that Ga Li, his brother Seleqi, and son Gandu had poisoned her food; his wife had adopted Gantai from another household and incited a mob to destroy the house.

sentences.zh: 下刑部鞫得實，擬噶禮當極刑，妻論絞，色勒奇、幹都皆斬，幹泰發黑龍江，家產沒入官。

translations.literal: The Board of Punishments tried the case and found it true; Ga Li was sentenced to the extreme penalty, his wife to strangulation, Seleqi and Gandu to decapitation, Gantai exiled to Heilongjiang, and the family property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of Punishments found the charges true: Ga Li was sentenced to death, his wife to strangulation, Seleqi and Gandu to decapitation, Gantai exiled to Heilongjiang, and the family property confiscated.

sentences.zh: 上令噶禮自盡，妻從死，餘如部議。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Ga Li to take his own life; his wife died with him; the rest followed the ministry recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Ga Li to take his own life; his wife died with him; the rest followed the ministry's recommendation.

sentences.zh: 論曰：廉吏往往不獲於上，豈長官皆不肖，抑其強項固有所不可堪歟？

translations.literal: The commentator says: Honest officials often fail to please their superiors—is it that all superiors are unworthy, or that their stubborn integrity is in some ways unbearable?
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Honest officials often fail to please their superiors—is every superior unworthy, or is their stubborn integrity sometimes unbearable?

sentences.zh: 隴其之廉，天顏知之而不能容。

translations.literal: Longqi's integrity Tianyan knew yet could not tolerate.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyan knew Longqi was honest yet could not tolerate him.

sentences.zh: 鵬年初扼於阿山，繼挫於噶禮，皆欲中以危法，抑又甚矣。

translations.literal: Pengnian was first strangled by A Shan, then thwarted by Ga Li; both wished to trap him with capital charges—yet that was even worse.
translations.idiomatic: Pengnian was first blocked by A Shan, then crushed by Ga Li; both tried to trap him with capital charges—an even graver wrong.

sentences.zh: 伯行與噶禮互劾，再讞不得直。

translations.literal: Boxing and Ga Li impeached each other; twice reheard, justice was not done.
translations.idiomatic: Boxing and Ga Li impeached each other; twice reheard, justice was not done.

sentences.zh: 幸賴聖祖仁明，隴其復起，鵬年致大用，伯行亦終獲全。

translations.literal: Fortunately relying on the Sage Ancestor's benevolence and clarity, Longqi was restored, Pengnian rose to great employment, and Boxing also ultimately survived whole.
translations.idiomatic: Fortunately the Sage Ancestor was benevolent and clear-sighted: Longqi was restored, Pengnian rose to high office, and Boxing ultimately survived unscathed.

sentences.zh: 二三正人詘而得申，人心風氣震盪洋溢，所被至遠。

translations.literal: When two or three upright men, though bent, could still prevail, the mood of the people and the moral atmosphere surged and spread—the influence reached far.
translations.idiomatic: When a few upright men, though bent low, could still prevail, public morale and moral tone surged and spread—the influence reached far.

sentences.zh: 噶禮不足以語此，蓋天顏、阿山亦弗能喻也。

translations.literal: Ga Li is not fit to speak of this; indeed Tianyan and A Shan also cannot be compared.
translations.idiomatic: Ga Li is not fit to speak of this; Tianyan and A Shan cannot be compared either.
